advancements.moleverse.a_find.descriptio: A worm with some substance to it. The colony can tell the difference, and pays like it.
advancements.moleverse.a_find.title: Worth Its Weight
advancements.moleverse.chitin.descriptio: A beetle leaves its plate behind. Nothing above ground grows one.
advancements.moleverse.chitin.title: Plated
advancements.moleverse.deeper.descriptio: Some things only exist below, and this is one of them.
advancements.moleverse.deeper.title: Deeper
advancements.moleverse.dig_in.descriptio: The walls down here are soil, and soil has things in it.
advancements.moleverse.dig_in.title: Dig In
advancements.moleverse.down_there.descri: The run a mole dug through one block of soil, at the size it is to a mole.
advancements.moleverse.down_there.title: Down There
advancements.moleverse.field_rations.des: Raw, gritty, and two paces from where you were standing. It will do.
advancements.moleverse.fitting.descripti: Every fitting answers the same question: has a mole just come up here?
advancements.moleverse.fitting.title: Fitted
advancements.moleverse.larder.descriptio: Worms, bitten so they cannot leave. A mole keeps a larder, and this one is not yours.
advancements.moleverse.larder.title: Somebody's Pantry
advancements.moleverse.nipped.descriptio: Shrews were here first, they are quicker than you, and there are three of them.
advancements.moleverse.nipped.title: Nipped
advancements.moleverse.not_today.descrip: A weasel works a corridor the way a mole does: end to end, without turning round.
advancements.moleverse.not_today.title: Not Today
advancements.moleverse.own_mound.descrip: Place one yourself. The moles will treat it as theirs, which is the point.
advancements.moleverse.own_mound.title: A Mound of Your Own
advancements.moleverse.root.description: A heap of earth where there was none, and whatever left it is not here now.
advancements.moleverse.root.title: Something Has Been Digging
advancements.moleverse.scale_of_it.descr: The same earthworm you farm, as tall as you are.
advancements.moleverse.scale_of_it.title: The Scale of It
advancements.moleverse.shored_up.descrip: A molehill is a heap. Give it a rim and it can carry something.
advancements.moleverse.shored_up.title: Shored Up
advancements.moleverse.the_nest.descript: Dry grass dragged into a dish. Every run in the colony comes back here.
advancements.moleverse.the_nest.title: The Middle of It
advancements.moleverse.warm_hollow.descr: A lid of moss over the one thing in a colony worth digging up.
advancements.moleverse.warm_hollow.title: The Warm Hollow
gui.moleverse.exchange_station.feed_hint: What one mole's trip costs, and what it pays.
gui.moleverse.exchange_station.finds_hin: One armful per trip. The colony picks what.
gui.moleverse.exchange_station.idle: Nothing in there a mole would take.
gui.moleverse.exchange_station.shaft: The shaft. A mole comes up, takes its pay, and leaves what it dug through.
item.moleverse.mound_attachment.hint: Sits on a prepared mole mound
item.moleverse.prepared_mole_mound.hint: Use on a mole mound to shore it up
message.moleverse.greeting: Hello, mole. The tunnels are waiting.
message.moleverse.mound_attachment.refus: Needs a prepared mole mound underneath.
message.moleverse.prepared_mole_mound.re: Goes on a mole mound - use it on one to shore it up.
moleverse.configuration.debugLogging.too: Write additional Moleverse debug output to the log.
moleverse.configuration.greetPlayer.tool: Greet the player with a Moleverse message when they join a world.
moleverse.configuration.title: Moleverse Configuration
